Toggle Player Movement (0.8)
Your Majesty Studio [YM]
​
Introduction
Have you ever found yourself in a situation where you wanted the player to be unable to move, but still allow other events to proceed?
Or maybe you were in a situation where you needed to create the autorun event just to prevent the player from moving?
Ever wanted just to restrict player movement for some time without using unnecessary events or additional steps?
Well, now it
IS
possible!
Features
Easy
turning on/off
the
player movement
on the map by plugin commands!
ATTENTION
: The functionality of this plugin has
LESS
priority than other movement-restricting events!
This means that, for example, you
WON'T
be able to allow movement while the message is being shown,
because the message restriction has
MORE
priority!
Compatability
This plugin should also be compatible with other plugins.
Installation
Put the plugin in the '
plugins
' folder inside your project.
Then enable the plugin via the RPG Maker MV editor.
How to Use
All you need to do is use the desired plugin command listed below.
Plugin Commands
DisablePlayerMovement
Click to expand...
It will prevent the player from moving on the map.
EnablePlayerMovement
Click to expand...
It will allow player movements on the map.
Terms and Credits
Mention of
"
YourMajestyStudio
"
in credits is needed for
commercial use
.
Plugin is allowed to be used in all kind of projects.

posts.author: 12yao
posts.body: sure!The function of this plugin is to automatically pop up a message box (a non-pausing message box) when a player is detected within a certain distance from a specific location. To use it, enter the following command into the event comment: <ActiveMessage: this this this>. It triggers 100% of the time when Toggle Player Movement is not activated, regardless of the method used. However, once player movement is disabled, the plugin can no longer be triggered.
